title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $200 on Ecovacs Deebot T90s Pro
excerpt: It picks up pet hair, mops up stains, and is voice-activated.
content_html:
SAVE $200: As of Nov. 5, the Ecovacs Deebot T90S Pro is on sale for $699 at Amazon. That's a 22% discount on the list price.

Credit: Ecovacs

$699 at Amazon
$899.99 Save $200.99

Vacuuming isn't exactly anyone's idea of a fun way to spend their free time. Fortunately, vacuums have come a long way from bulky devices dragged across your floors that still manage to miss awkward corners. Robot vacuums can now do the hard work for you, navigating your floors, avoiding obstacles, and tackling everyday dirt while you get on with something else.

As of Nov. 5, there's a deal on the Ecovacs Deebot T90S Pro that saves you $200 on the list price, now down to $699. It vacuums, it mops, and it even manages its own maintenance.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

This truly is a great robot vacuum if you want floor cleaning gone from your mind. It combines powerful vacuuming with continuous fresh-water mopping to tackle everything from everyday dust and pet hair to sticky kitchen spills. It has an OZMO ROLLER 3.0 system that uses 32-way pressurized water flow to rinse the roller as it cleans, and a scraper that removes dirty water to help prevent smearing and the spread of grime across hard floors.

For vacuuming, it delivers up to 40,000Pa of suction and features anti-tangle brushes designed to reduce hair wrap. Plus, the OMNI Station handles maintenance, including automatic dust removal, hot-water roller washing, hot-air drying, and cleaning-solution dispensing.
